title: Fix date/time parsing — add invariant culture format providers across all files
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
12 instances across multiple files where `DateTime.Parse`/`ToString` is called without `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture` or `IFormatProvider`:

- `CodeSearchService.cs` (L1480, L1695, L1751, L1843, L1850) — 5 instances
- `ChatServices.cs` (L901) — 1 instance
- `Chat.razor` (L983) — 1 instance
- `TrainingWorkbench.razor` (L518, L595) — 2 instances
- `LoggingObservabilityService.cs` (L402) — 1 instance
- `Training/ChatFeedbackStore.cs` (L225, L226) — 2 instances

## Impact
Datetime parsing without invariant culture causes failures on machines with non-US locale settings (e.g., dd/MM/yyyy vs MM/dd/yyyy).

## Action Required
Add `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture` to all `DateTime.Parse`/`DateTime.TryParse`/`ToString` calls. Use `DateTime.ParseExact` with explicit format strings where applicable.

## Effort
~2h

## Priority
P2 — Reliability
